items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms John Williams was in the Andy Kirk band, but the mention of MaryLou Williams is solely by the interviewer as John Williams' wife; the interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with her.

ctx.x: two good tenor players, Don Bias and Dick Wilson -- and he had one of my favorite lead trumpet players, Big Jim -- and I don't know Big Jim's last name, but he was one of the great trumpet players of all time.

Yeah. Jim ... I know his name because he works for the subway now, if he hasn't passed away, because my wife was a friend of his wife's. And they also had a John Williams, MaryLou Williams' husband, who was a baritone sax player.
That's right, John Williams was in that Andy Kirk band, and Floyd Smith was on the guitar.
